nodes.label: Measuring the Gap Between Human and LLM Research Ideas
nodes.author: Ziyu Chen, Yilun Zhao, Arman Cohan
nodes.rationale: Evaluates LLM-generated research ideas against human ideas from papers using literature-grounded ideation task. Finds LLMs concentrate on bridge-and-synthesis ideas while humans distribute across broader opportunity patterns.

nodes.label: Two-Axis Research-Taste Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Opportunity Pattern axis (why research needed): Puzzle/Contradiction, Explanation Gap, Scope Mismatch, Evidence Gap, Bridge Opportunity, Failure/Risk Gap, Resource Bottleneck. Method Paradigm axis (how contribution made): Synthesis/Unification, Relax/Extend Scope, Robustification, Formal Derivation, Empirical Mapping, Artifact/System, Optimization/Search.

nodes.label: Distributional Gap Finding
nodes.rationale: LLM ideas occupy narrower region of research-taste taxonomy. Only 12.1% of human ideas motivated by bridge opportunity vs 47.1–64.2% for LLMs. Only 5.1% of human ideas use synthesis vs 22.5–38.7% for LLMs. Human entropy consistently higher on both axes.

nodes.label: Diagnostic Scores
nodes.rationale: Surface stitching (superficial combination), bottleneck specificity (precise mechanism), boilerplate (generic phrasing). Most models receive lower specificity and higher boilerplate than humans, especially Qwen models.

nodes.label: Extended Reasoning Ablation
nodes.rationale: Enabling thinking mode increases bridge opportunities and synthesis, increases TVD from human distribution, lowers entropy. Reasoning sharpens model's preferred template rather than broadening toward human taste.

nodes.label: Archetype Clustering Analysis
nodes.rationale: Model outputs concentrate on reusable template moves (integrate 34.2% vs 2.35%, unify 8.2% vs 1.9%). Human ideas use local interventions (replace 9.13% vs 0.92%, decouple 2.33% vs 0.21%). Human-heavy clusters achieve higher bottleneck specificity and lower boilerplate.

nodes.label: Concept Enrichment Analysis
nodes.rationale: Model-enriched clusters are high-frequency technical motifs (multi-omics, diffusion policy, multimodal). Human-enriched clusters are narrower mechanisms (trajectories, ligands, tokenization, equivariance). Models wrap concepts in safe integration moves; humans modify local mechanisms.

nodes.label: Full-Paper Context Ablation
nodes.rationale: Richer context (full-paper summaries vs abstracts) does not move models closer to human distribution. TVD and JSD increase on both axes; entropy decreases. Bridge-and-synthesis preference persists.

nodes.label: Evaluation Corpus
nodes.rationale: 11,683 valid human ideas from ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS (2023–2026) and Nature Communications (2023–2025). 5,994 ML papers, 5,689 Nature papers. Each paper paired with LLM-generated ideas from reconstructed prior-work context.

nodes.label: Models Evaluated
nodes.rationale: Nine model settings: Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B, GPT-5.4-mini, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Reasoning ablation on Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
